title: Move UBC Classroom Stretching Video
content_markdown:
[Embedded iframe \(view source\)](https://www.youtube.com/embed/7JuFVntDDR8)

We spend 50\-70% of our day sitting, and this sedentary behaviour can have negative implications for our health and wellbeing\. The [Kinesiology Undergraduate Society](http://kus.ubc.ca/) shares their top tips for moving more, even when facing a busy day of classes and studying, by incorporating small stretches and exercises into the classroom\. 

*Learn more about Move UBC [here](http://www.move.ubc.ca/)\.*

title: Suicide Awareness & Intervention Training (SAIT)
content_markdown:
In response to the needs of our campus community, UBC has transitioned from the QPR program and has created the custom Suicide Awareness and Intervention Training \(SAIT\) that is from a post\-secondary context, is trauma\-informed, and has cultural context\.  
  
This is a free, introductory course for any UBC Vancouver and Okanagan students, faculty, staff and alumni\. There are no prerequisites; while training will give you skills to help someone, you’re not expected to become an expert\. 

[Learn more about SAIT](https://wellbeing.ubc.ca/sait)

2\.5\-3 hrs

title: Wellness Workshops for Students
content_markdown:
The [UBC Wellness Centre](https://students.ubc.ca/health/wellness-centre) offers a variety of workshops for students\. Learn to balance your academic commitments with your physical and mental wellness, manage your time effectively, communicate about sex, sexual health and consent, and much more\. 

Visit the [Wellness Workshops page](https://students.ubc.ca/health/wellness-centre/wellness-workshops) for a full list of workshops for students\. You can also request a workshop for a specific group\.

title: NURS 180 Stress and Strategies to Promote Wellbeing
content_markdown:
This nursing elective course offers an introduction to foundational knowledge related to stress, stressors, resilience, social support, and strategies to foster physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health\. Open to all students interested in learning about managing and navigating the stressors of student life\.

[Learn more here](https://nursing.ubc.ca/undergraduate/nurs-elective-courses)

title: Wellness Workshops for Student Leaders
content_markdown:
The [UBC Wellness Centre](https://students.ubc.ca/health/wellness-centre) offers a variety of workshops for student leaders\. Workshops will help you navigate conversations with peers in need of support, plan inclusive health and wellness events, learn to be a role\-model for wellbeing, and more\.

Visit the [Wellness Workshops page](https://students.ubc.ca/health/wellness-centre/wellness-workshops) for more information on workshops for student leaders\. You can also request a workshop for a specific group\.
